verdict.rationale: Recurring automation is a plausible question for a state business-services portal, for example auto-filing periodic reports or scheduled data pulls, so the axis applies. However, the evidence shows no product-provided way to schedule recurring jobs or workflows. Periodic report filing and trade name renewal are one-off filing actions, not recurring schedules. Email notifications are an adjacent alerting feature. The keyless Socrata data API is a developer building block on a host platform, so none of these earn credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
